why_best: This subtle specular reaction establishes an atmosphere of high-end craftsmanship without moving a single data point on a dense dashboard.
why_bad: Physically sliding or bouncing UI elements into place would create unnecessary visual noise, cluttering the reader's attention during critical data assessment.
trap: A careless execution will slide a detached semi-transparent overlay across the scene rather than ensuring every embedded surface element recalculates its specular highlights synchronously with the beam.
